verdict.rationale: Documenting a non-resident path to incorporation is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. No page content was retrieved, so nothing documents eligibility, accepted foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for foreign founders. Low confidence reflects that the content was never fetched, not that it is absent.
